crossRefs.note: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh…
Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither…
Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…

translations.web: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
translations.bsb: Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
translations.kjv: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
translations.asv: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts; Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved. Psalm 81 For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of Asaph.
